text:
oncall_jess: Heads-up: multiple hosted customers reported 503s around 21:12 UTC. I'm seeing upstream inference workers on gpu-72 (us-west-2a) exit with code 134. attaching first-pass logs.

oncall_jess: ```
[2026-03-16T21:12:04Z] runner[pid=2145] Abort (CUDA device reset)
stack trace: ...
CUDA Error: unspecified launch failure
GPU reset detected, container restarted
```

sre_miguel: Can you paste the container logs + dmesg? Also are we seeing OOM kill or driver reset?

oncall_jess: dmesg shows "NVRM: GPU at 0000:00:1e.0: GPU has fallen off the bus" followed by driver unload/reload. Not classic host OOM. suspect driver crash.

infra_anya: We rolled a kernel/driver to that pool last night (probe). Kernel 5.15.0-88 + driver 535.x. Could be regression. Isolating node now.

support_liam: Affected customers: corp-alpha, mid-saas-42, and a handful of endpoints. Customers report retries spike and 5xx TTL exceeded. Opened tickets and added sample request id rid_8a9c.

eng_runtime_olga: Could be kv-prefetch path hitting pinned pages during prefetch causing page-fault handling -> driver reset. Need a quick repro with minimal payload.

oncall_jess: Repro steps I'm running:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-large","batch_size":4,"sequence_len":2048,"prompt":"a"}'
```
After ~20-30 requests the GPU resets. Heap snapshot: https://artifacts.redwd/heap/2401234567.snap

eng_runtime_olga: Debug collector:
```bash
export RD_DEBUG_KERNEL=1
rdctl collect --node gpu-72 --since 21:00 --out /tmp/collection.tgz
```

deploy_bot: Auto rollback scheduled: rolling driver rollback in us-west-2a pool to 530.41 scheduled in 5m. CI tests passed. :gear:

infra_anya: Cordon + drain gpu-72 now, repro on isolated lab node. ETA ~12m.

sre_miguel: If driver regression we should add routing fallback to cpu inference for affected customers to reduce 503s. Can we toggle routing policy quickly?

oncall_jess: :thumbsup: toggled routing for corp-alpha and mid-saas-42 to fallback 'dedicated-cpu' tier. Error rate down ~80% in dashboards.

support_liam: I'll notify customers, offer credits for the window. Tickets linked: https://support.redwood/t/7421

eng_runtime_olga: Next steps: 1) collect kernel crash dumps + full coredump, 2) reproduce in lab with same driver+kernel combo, 3) prepare hotfix pin to previous driver, 4) write postmortem. I own reproducer and P1.

oncall_jess: Update: rollback started, nodes rejoined, no new 503s in last 10m. Closing incident once we validate core dumps. :white_check_mark:
